name: forbiddance
lore:
# On the Rite of Forbiddance

To cast *Forbiddance* is to impose the sovereign will of the Prime Material upon the chaotic drift of the cosmos. As the ritual concludes, the air does not merely shimmer; it **crystallizes**. Observers witness a lattice of auric ley-lines etching themselves into the flagstones, glowing with the steady, cold light of a star born of law.

Shaping this magic feels less like weaving silk and more like forging iron. The Weave grows dense, resisting the caster’s touch until it "snaps" into a rigid, immutable grid. To stand within the warded area is to feel a profound stillness, as if the very atoms of the room have been locked in a divine embrace.

**The Legend of the Iron Anchor**
Chronicles speak of Arch-Prelate Valerius, who found his cathedral besieged by the skittering horrors of the Abyss. Rather than flee, he knelt and struck the earth with his staff, chanting for six hours as the stone cracked. He did not just pray for protection; he anchored the sanctuary to the foundations of reality itself. When the first demon crossed the threshold, it did not merely die—it was rejected by the world, dissolving into cinders before it could draw a single breath.
